spec.claim_summary: A strategy that buys Ether when its 50-day simple moving average crosses above its 200-day simple moving average and exits 180 days later.

claimed.other: the largest and only loss following a Golden Cross signal is less than one percent

assumptions: Asset is Ether mapped to Binance spot ETHUSDT; the claim says Ether's / ETH.
Timeframe is 1d inferred from 50-day, 200-day and 180-days lengths; rules evaluated on daily bar closes.
Direction is long inferred from buying the Golden Cross signal and selling 180 days later.
Entry uses close-based simple moving averages with lengths 50 and 200 exactly as stated.
Exit is time-based only with max_hold_bars 180 from Sell 180 days later; no stop, target or trailing stop was stated.
Engine mechanics apply: evaluated on bar closes, fill at next bar open, one position at a time over all history; any period cited is recorded in claimed, not as a test window.

evidence.quote: Ether's 50-day sma crosses above its 200-day sma
The average trade of +59.2% in just 180 days
the largest and only loss following a Golden Cross signal is less than one percent
